subject: Portal invite delivered but accept flow redirects and logs out immediately - Astral Components
messages:
From: Katie Hart <katie.hart@astralcomponents.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-22T09:12:00Z
Subject: Trouble accepting supplier invite — keeps bouncing to login

Hi David / Ben,

We received the supplier portal invite this morning (thank you). When our procurement admin clicks the accept link it briefly shows the activation page, then immediately redirects to the login screen and we land back at our IdP. After completing SSO on the IdP we end up back at the portal but with a blank profile and are not authenticated — the accept button is gone.

We tried Chrome and Edge on Windows 10 and also tried a mobile browser; behavior is the same. Attached is a screenshot of the final page and a small copy of the response headers we captured (accept-event-headers.txt).

Can you advise what to check? We have an upcoming PO that needs to be approved and this blocks us from completing the vendor setup.

Thanks,
Katie Hart
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Astral Components

Attachment: sso-error-screenshot.png (image/png)
Attachment: accept-event-headers.txt (text/plain)
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Katie Hart <katie.hart@astralcomponents.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-22T09:38:00Z
Subject: Re: Trouble accepting supplier invite — keeps bouncing to login

Hi Katie — sorry for the disruption and thanks for the clear info + attachments.

Quick asks while we triage:
- Can you confirm whether your IdP sets any SameSite cookie policies or injects headers?
- Do you see any browser console errors when the redirect happens?
- If possible, please forward the full response headers around the redirect (you already sent the accept-event snippet, that's helpful).

I've looped in Ben from Integrations and CC'd Marissa from Platform so we can check routing / cookie domain behavior on our side. We'll prioritize — I see SUP-4321 assigned and will update the ticket with logs.

I'll follow up with next steps in ~30–60 minutes.

—David
David Kim | Partner Ops (Redwood Inference)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Katie Hart <katie.hart@astralcomponents.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-22T11:00:00Z
Subject: Re: Trouble accepting supplier invite — keeps bouncing to login

Thanks Katie. A couple of notes from the integration side:

1) Common symptom: if the portal's session cookie domain doesn't match the final redirect domain we see the accept flow create a session then immediately lose it on the first cross-site navigation. That looks like a SameSite or domain scoping issue.

2) Can you try accepting the invite in an Incognito window with third-party cookies allowed (temporarily) to rule out a cookie policy? If that works it's almost certainly a cookie scoping/SameSite thing.

3) Marissa — can you pull a short snippet from the gateway logs for the accept token around 2028-03-22T09:10–09:15Z (we need the Set-Cookie and first POST handshake). I suspect the Set-Cookie has Domain=.portal.redwood.com but the redirect target is portal.partner.redwood.com in their flow — mismatch.

Katie — if incognito + third-party cookies works, let us know and we'll push a hotfix to relax SameSite for the accept-token cookie for partner flows.

Ben
Senior Integrations Engineer
From: Katie Hart <katie.hart@astralcomponents.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-22T13:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Trouble accepting supplier invite — keeps bouncing to login

Ben / David — we tried incognito with third-party cookies enabled and the accept flow completes (we now see the 'Welcome to Redwood' confirmation and a partially filled profile). So that workaround works for us for the moment.

I also forwarded the raw response headers we captured; here's the key line that looked odd to us: 

Set-Cookie: rwd_session=eyJ...; Domain=portal.redwood.com; Path=/; Secure; SameSite=Lax

But when the IdP returns us the final handoff it lands at portal.partner.redwood.com (CNAME for partner-hosted redirect). If the cookie domain doesn't match the CNAME the browser will drop it on cross-site handoff.

If you can relax SameSite to None for the accept flow cookie and scope Domain=.redwood.com (or add portal.partner.redwood.com) that would likely fix. Happy to test again after you push any change.

Thanks — Katie
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Katie Hart <katie.hart@astralcomponents.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-22T16:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Trouble accepting supplier invite — keeps bouncing to login

Katie — thanks for confirming the incognito workaround and for capturing the headers.

We investigated and pushed a targeted change: the accept-token cookie is now set with SameSite=None; Secure; Domain=.redwood.com and we added portal.partner.redwood.com to the allowed redirect host list for the accept flow. I also attached a short gateway-logs-snippet.txt with the Set-Cookie before/after and the POST sequence for SUP-4321.

Please retry the invite in a regular browser (not incognito) and let us know. If you still see issues try clearing cookies for portal.redwood.com and portal.partner.redwood.com, then click the invite again.

I'll keep SUP-4321 open until we get confirmation from you that onboarding completed and you can see the PO visibility.

—David
